# Using rules sets

The default ASDT ruleset, __ASDT Commit & PR Management__, is defined in  ASDT_Commit_PR_Ruleset.json.  

Any other JSON files present are either examples, or special purpose examples.

This rule set (and any other samples if present) can be applied by through the Github browser interface by:

1. Making sure that there is a local copy of the file containing the rules JSON
2. Clicking on the repository to Settings button
3. Select "Code, planning, and automation" -> "Rules -> "Rulesets"
4. Selecting "New ruleset" and clicking on "Import a ruleset" to import the rules file saved above.
